# 2023-01-17

## Leaflet Maps

This is a generic Map with speed of the cars 

```{r cars}
library(leaflet)
summary(cars)
set.seed(2026-01-17)
cars$lat <- runif(50, min = 39.2, max = 39.3)
cars$lng <- runif(50, min = -76.6, max = -76.5)
cars %>% 
  leaflet() %>%
  addTiles() %>%
  addMarkers(clusterOptions = markerClusterOptions())
```
